Welcome to Carolina Pintos Therapy, the premier destination in Houston for specialized therapeutic services. Our clinic excels in Lymphatic Massage, expert Post-Operative Treatment (including BBL, Tummy Tuck, C-Section, and Liposuction recovery), Post-Cancer Care, Pre & Post-Pregnancy Wellness, Aesthetic Body Slimming, and comprehensive Therapy for General Surgery and Injury Recovery.

What sets us apart? We're not just a therapy clinic; we're a hub of medical excellence and patient-centered care. Led by renowned Physical Therapist Carolina Pintos, our experienced, medically-trained massage therapists are at the forefront of the industry. With over 25 doctors recommending us, our reputation for high-quality care, advanced medical expertise, and exceptional customer service speaks for itself.

Stay tuned to our channel for insights into our therapy techniques, success stories, health tips, and much more.
